title: 托管资产超60万亿：纽约梅隆银行Q2营收创纪，能否持续？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Record performance in Q1, again in Q2.
segments.zh: 第一季度业绩创纪录，第二季度同样强劲。

segments.en: What's behind the activity, Derma? And the question I think that applies to your bank and so many others this morning is can this continue?
segments.zh: Derma，是什么推动了这些活动？今早很多银行都面临一个问题：这种势头能否持续？

segments.en: Thanks for having me, Jonathan, and great to be with you. When I was getting ready for the show this morning, I wasn't too sure whether to put the tie on
segments.zh: 谢谢邀请，Jonathan。今早准备节目时，我犹豫是打领带还是穿英格兰球衣，最后选了领带。

segments.en: or put the England shirt on, so I put the tie on.
segments.zh: 希望你们今天能赢，享受下午的比赛。

segments.en: But hopefully you'll bring it home today and enjoy the match this afternoon.
segments.zh: 今天BNY的业绩很好，我们对表现非常满意。

segments.en: Listen, B&Y today, great results were really pleased with the performance.
segments.zh: 公司目前运转良好。我们构建了持久性强的架构，以抓住市场机遇。

segments.en: We feel like the firm is humming at the moment. We've built the company for durability and to take advantage of opportunities like this that the market has presented over the last quarter.
segments.zh: 美国经济强劲，我们持续看好。

segments.en: The US economy is strong. We continue to be positive on the US economy.
segments.zh: 充分就业、收益率曲线表现良好、资金流入强劲，这些都令人乐观。

segments.en: There's a lot to be optimistic about in terms of what's happening, full employment.
segments.zh: 当前形势令人乐观，充分就业。

segments.en: The yield curve is behaving well. Flows are strong.
segments.zh: 收益率曲线表现良好，资金流入强劲。

segments.en: And when you have a company like ours who has built a broad set of durable businesses and has been in this for a long time, with 20% of the world's investable assets
segments.zh: 像我们这样拥有广泛且持久业务的公司，长期深耕于此，全球20%的可**资产每天流经我们的系统。

segments.en: flowing through your pipes every day, this shows up in kind of record net revenues which were just posed in this morning of $5.7 billion.
segments.zh: 这体现在今早公布的57亿美元创纪录净收入上。

segments.en: So as a company, we're very pleased, please, but we feel like we have more white space to go and more opportunity and we're going to keep pushing on
segments.zh: 作为公司，我们非常满意，但我们认为还有更多空间和机会，我们将继续推进到下半年。

segments.en: into the second half of the year. And then record assets under custody as well, north of 60 trillion.
segments.zh: 同时，托管资产也创下纪录，超过60万亿美元。
